title: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 is potentially vulnerable to denial of service due to uncontrolled…
description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway versions 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 contain a vulnerability that allows an authenticated user with tool-registration privileges to cause a denial of service. This occurs due to uncontrolled regular expression complexity (ReDoS) in the JSON Schema pattern field, which can lead to excessive CPU consumption during argument validation, potentially degrading gateway availability.
